integrity: Self-contained exact finite normal-form proof with standalone standard-library checker; every reported orbit and histogram is computed using integer arithmetic, with independent code and direct transform evaluations.
scientific_limitations: Nine-element unweighted supports in F_2^5, unlabeled absolute Walsh-magnitude histograms. Does not address labeled phaseless recovery, other dimensions or cardinalities; historical short-code tables may encode parts of the classification. No independent mathematical audit.
title: Exact phaseless Walsh ambiguity for nine-point binary five-space
